description: Major AWS-1 auction. 1710-1755/2110-2155 MHz paired spectrum for 3G/4G services.
Landmark 700 MHz auction. Blocks A-E. Verizon won C block, AT&T won B block. $19.6B total. Google bid on C block to trigger open access rules.
Single broadcast permit for Blanco, Texas.
LPTV and TV translator digital companion channels.
Broadband Radio Service licenses in 2.5 GHz band.
218-219 MHz and Phase II 220 MHz licenses.
Leftover licenses from Auction 73. 16 licenses from the original 700 MHz auction.
H Block licenses 1915-1920/1995-2000 MHz. Dish Network won all 176 licenses at exactly the reserve price of $1.564B.
Record-breaking AWS-3 auction: 1695-1710/1755-1780/2155-2180 MHz. AT&T $18.2B, Verizon $10.4B, Dish (via Northstar/SNR) $13.3B gross, T-Mobile $1.77B.
Second window for AM Revitalization FM translators.
28 GHz 5G spectrum. Verizon $505.7M (1066 licenses), US Cellular $129.4M (408 licenses).
24 GHz 5G spectrum. AT&T $982.5M (831 licenses), T-Mobile $803.2M (1346 licenses).
Largest mmWave auction: 3400 MHz of spectrum. AT&T (FiberTower) $1.2B, Verizon (Straight Path) $1.6B, T-Mobile $873M.
Citizens Broadband Radio Service PAL auction. Most licenses ever auctioned (22,631). Verizon, Dish, Comcast, Charter among top bidders.
Largest auction in FCC history: $81.2B. 280 MHz of C-band spectrum. Verizon $45.4B (3511 licenses), AT&T $23.4B (1621 licenses), T-Mobile $9.3B (142 licenses).
2.5 GHz EBS licenses. T-Mobile dominated with $304M winning 90% of licenses (7156 of 7872). Far below analyst estimates of $1-5B.
AM and FM broadcast construction permits.
3.45-3.55 GHz mid-band 5G spectrum. Third highest grossing auction. AT&T $9.1B (1624 lic), Dish (Weminuche) $7.3B (1232 lic), T-Mobile $2.9B (199 lic). Verizon did not participate.
Historic broadcast incentive auction forward component. T-Mobile $7.99B (1525 licenses, 45% of all spectrum), Dish $6.2B, Comcast $1.7B, US Cellular $328M, AT&T $910M. Verizon did not bid.
Reverse auction component where broadcasters relinquished spectrum rights. 175 stations gave up spectrum for $10.05B.
Combined incentive auction: $19.8B forward + $10.05B reverse. Net proceeds ~$7.3B to Treasury after broadcaster payouts and relocation costs.
